summary: XCel Brands, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, disclosing entry into an asset purchase agreement dated April 24, 2026, for the sale of substantially all assets of its subsidiary JR Licensing, including the Judith Ripka brand. The buyer, Judith Ripka Designs, LLC, pays $2.3 million cash at closing plus up to $0.75 million in contingent consideration. No board recommendation or financial advisor is mentioned. The deal transfers brand and trademark assets. What to watch: completion of the cash payment and earn-out milestones; risk-arb focuses on asset delivery and contingent consideration.
